```{r libraries, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)

library(scoringutils)
library(hubUtils)
library(hubEnsembles)

```

# Data
```{r}
state_coverage <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/state-scoring/state_coverage.csv")
# state_coverage_summary <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/state-scoring/state_coverage_summary.csv")
state_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/state-scoring/state_wis.csv")
# state_wis_summary <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/state-scoring/state_wis_summary.csv")

standard_coverage <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_coverage.csv")
# standard_coverage_summary <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_coverage_summary.csv")
standard_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_wis.csv")
# standard_wis_summary <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_wis_summary.csv")
```

# Subfigures
## Top left
```{r}
temp1a_state = state_wis |> group_by(model_id, target) |>  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1a_state$type = "state-scoring"

temp1a_standard = standard_wis |> group_by(model_id, target) |>  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1a_standard$type = "standard-scoring"

temp1a = rbind(temp1a_standard, temp1a_state)
temp1a = temp1a |> filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct")
```

```{r}
figure1a = ggplot(temp1a, aes(x = fct_reorder(model_id, mean_wis, .fun = max), y = mean_wis, fill = type)) + 
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("standard-scoring" = "firebrick", "state-scoring" = "royalblue")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2.5), breaks = c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3),
                     expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = 0.03)) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean WIS", fill = "Scoring Method") + 
  theme_bw() + theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)  
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") + 
  coord_flip()

figure1a
```

## Top right
```{r}
temp1b_state = state_wis |> group_by(model_id, location, target) |>  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

temp1b_standard = standard_wis |> group_by(model_id, location, target) |>  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

temp1b = rbind(temp1b_standard, temp1b_state)
temp1b = temp1b |> filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct")
```

```{r, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 10}
figure1b = ggplot(temp1b, aes(x = fct_inorder(model_id), y = fct_inorder(location), fill = mean_wis)) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1) +
  geom_tile() + 
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Location", fill = "Mean WIS") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "top") + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)  
  )
figure1b
```

## Bottom left
```{r}
state_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/state-scoring/state_wis.csv")
state_wis = state_wis |> rename(state_wis = wis)

complete_wis <- state_wis %>%
  left_join(standard_wis, by = intersect(colnames(state_wis), colnames(standard_wis)))

complete_wis$relative_wis <- complete_wis$state_wis / complete_wis$wis
complete_wis = complete_wis |> select("location", "target_end_date", "horizon", "reference_date",  "model_id", "target", "wis",  "state_wis",    "relative_wis")
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(complete_wis)) 
complete_wis = na.omit(complete_wis)
```
```{r}
complete_wis_summary <- complete_wis %>%
  group_by(model_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_relative_wis = mean(relative_wis[!is.infinite(relative_wis)]),
    count = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
temp1c = complete_wis_summary |> filter(model_id != "epiENGAGE-GBQR")
```

```{r}
figure1c = ggplot(temp1c, aes(x = fct_reorder(model_id, mean_relative_wis, .fun = sum), y = mean_relative_wis)) + 
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick", color = "black") + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = 0.03)) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean Relative WIS (values exceeding 1 are infinite)") + 
   theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)  
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") + 
  coord_flip()

figure1c
```


## Bottom right
```{r}
temp1d_state = state_coverage |> group_by(model_id, target) |>  
  summarise(mean_coverage = mean(coverage_95), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1d_state$type = "state-scoring"

temp1d_standard = standard_coverage |> group_by(model_id, target) |> 
  summarise(mean_coverage = mean(coverage_95), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1d_standard$type = "standard-scoring"

temp1d = rbind(temp1d_standard, temp1d_state)
temp1d = temp1d |> filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct")
```

```{r}
figure1d = ggplot(temp1d, aes(x = fct_reorder(model_id, mean_coverage, .fun = max), y = mean_coverage, fill = type)) + 
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("standard-scoring" = "firebrick", "state-scoring" = "royalblue")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = 0.03)) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean Coverage (95%)", fill = "Scoring Method") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17)  
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") + 
  coord_flip()

figure1d
```

```{r, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 20}
(figure1a + figure1b) / (figure1c + figure1d)
```
